<script>
METHOD = """
    // added in the web copy only (the core copy was never updated) - restored after the module merge
    public static String farewell(String name) {
        return "bye, " + name;
    }
"""


def fix(p):
    for path in p.files("**/com/example/shop/shared/Shared.java"):
        text = p.read(path)
        if "farewell(" in text:
            p.log(f"{path}: farewell already there")
            continue
        end = text.rstrip().rfind("}")
        if end < 0:
            p.log(f"{path}: no class body end found")
            continue
        p.write(path, text[:end].rstrip("\n") + "\n" + METHOD + text[end:])
        p.log(f"{path}: farewell(String) added from the dropped web copy")
